description: This file defines a controller class 'MyReviewController' within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. The class extends AbstractVueController and overrides the preRender method to set up a Vue component named 'my-reviews'. The file serves as part of the server-side logic for handling user review-related views in the HRM system.

classes.name: MyReviewController
classes.description: Controller for handling 'My Reviews' view in the performance module, extends AbstractVueController to render Vue.js components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating a 'my-reviews' Vue component and setting it for rendering.
